a.geometry: Every ribbon is one actual native tskit edge from its child to parent over exactly edge.left..edge.right. Three exact full-ARG marginal slices are at their interval midpoints. Global node horizontal coordinate is a constant display coordinate derived from the union of true descendants. Ribbon opacity encodes no probability. No invented lineage connectors.
a.recombination: native node flags & 131072, diamond at original recorded time

b.topology: exact three unary-collapsed marginals, original node ages and planar sample order
b.alleles: one actual hypothetical observed site per toy interval, full.genotype_matrix()[interval_index,sample_id]; all five genotypes observed
b.references: r1 Ana, r2 CHG, r3 WHG, r4 EHG. Known one-hot order Ana/CHG/WHG/EHG. q1 is displayed as ?, abbreviating the real zero ancestry-vector plus unknown indicator; alleles stay observed.
b.internal_feature: genuine internal nonroot node with age tau, root=0, sampled=0. No ancestral ancestry label.
b.abstraction: The main figure abbreviates full site/frequency/callability/age feature encoding, defined in Methods. It does not substitute one scalar allele for the actual encoder.
b.all_observed_input_collector: single frame around all panel-b observed input glyphs and one connected exit to MLP; edges separately define GNN traversals

c.input: MLP icon summarizes site/leaf/node encoders and additive initialization at every node b_v
c.GNN: Both GNN_theta(T_t) modules complete upward and downward traversals of every node of every local tree, with identical learned weights and observed gates. Tree glyphs use genuine T1 topology as representative operator icons. They do not replace changing input topologies.
c.structural: Delta_str is the sum of gained/lost and eligible own-state local residuals. Its input is only the current node state plus observed topology conditioning. No arrow imports another tree's learned internal-node state.
c.base_residual: The b_v junction supplies the upper lane into plus. The first-GNN output junction supplies separate structure and sample-memory branches. The plus returns b_v + Delta_str + Delta_memory to traversal2.
c.sample_memory: Displayed Bidirectional EMA is actual sample-memory operation. It abbreviates cut representative projection, assignment to each sampled identity, independent forward/reverse physical-span-decay EMA scans, direction average, current-group average and current-context subtraction. Explicit Linear is the real learned output projection to width32 at current cut representatives. Full equations remain in Methods.
c.identity: q1,r1,r2,r3,r4 is one fixed visual row permutation in memory and readout across all3trees. Display order is independent of changing planar tip order; sample identities never merge.
c.readout: A learned per-sample projection of second-pass upward/outside states gives e_tq; the matrix glyphs preserve all samples, not whole-graph pooling. One-layer BiGRU receives these embeddings and observed geometry for every sample. Concat joins local32 with recurrent64, then the inherited classifier makes four probabilities.
c.geometry: I_t strip abbreviates log-scaled interval width and left/right neighboring-center distances. No geometry feature is omitted from actual model.
c.output: Only displayed output selects q1. Exact same illustrative probability array and calls as v10/v7. Output I1,I2,I3 labels match exact native breakpoint widths. No fitted predictions.

simplifications: Full feature encoders, observed gates, two structural-residual equations, cut grouping, forcing/history/centering algebra and geometry coordinates remain defined in Methods. The figure communicates operation order and persistent sample identity without claiming complete equations are recoverable from the image alone.
